description: This source file appears to be a Markdown documentation file describing the 'Download' class within a Playwright API, including various methods and usage examples in multiple programming languages.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Represents a download object in Playwright, providing methods to handle downloaded files, such as saving, deleting, and retrieving information about the download.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a download. Will not fail if the download is already finished or canceled. Upon successful cancellations, `download.failure()` would resolve to `'canceled'`.

methods.name: createReadStream
methods.description: Returns a readable stream for a successful download, or throws for a failed/canceled download.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the downloaded file, waiting for the download to finish if necessary.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns the download error if any. Will wait for the download to finish if necessary.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Gets the page that the download belongs to.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns path to the downloaded file for a successful download, or throws for a failed or canceled download. Waits for the download to finish if necessary.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Copies the download to a user-specified path; can be called while the download is in progress. Waits for the download to finish if necessary.

methods.name: suggestedFilename
methods.description: Returns the suggested filename for this download, typically derived from the Content-Disposition header or download attribute.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL from which the download occurred.
